supplements.title: Berberine induces pyroptosis by promoting the NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Berberine, a natural compound from Chinese herbal medicine, kills papillary thyroid cancer cells by triggering a specific cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Integrated phytochemical and computational approaches to identify candidate Bcl-2 inhibitors from Caesalpinia mimosoides: Toward translational anticancer strategies.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified plant compounds from Caesalpinia mimosoides that effectively block Bcl-2 cancer protein, offering natural alternatives to synthetic drugs.

supplements.title: Exploration of the pharmacological mechanism of Evodia rutaecarpa on esophageal cancer based on comprehensive analysis of compounds and disease targets.
supplements.summary: Evodia rutaecarpa compounds inhibit esophageal cancer cell growth by stopping cell cycle and triggering cell death through multiple molecular targets.

supplements.title: Targeting Warburg effect: involvement of lactate transporter MCT1 and its chaperone in cancer cell killing by 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid.
supplements.summary: A licorice-derived compound kills cancer cells by exploiting their lactate transporter, which is overexpressed due to rapid metabolism.

supplements.title: Xanthan gum intake modifies the colon microbiota profile and causes mild colon inflammation in rats.
supplements.summary: Xanthan gum, commonly used in food, causes mild colon inflammation and alters gut bacteria in rats.

supplements.title: Natural flavonoid isoorientin and its anticancer mechanisms: a systematic review.
supplements.summary: Isoorientin, a plant-derived flavonoid, kills multiple cancer types by triggering cell death and stopping growth in laboratory studies.

supplements.title: Timing of Moderate-to-Vigorous Physical Activity and Mortality Risk: Role of Chronotype and Sleep Patterns.
supplements.summary: Morning exercise may reduce mortality risk more than evening exercise, particularly for early risers and those with consistent sleep patterns.

supplements.title: Phenethyl Isothiocyanate Suppresses Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression and Immune Evasion via ZNF652 Regulation of PD-L1.
supplements.summary: PEITC, a plant compound, reduces liver cancer growth and boosts immune therapy by lowering PD-L1 protein levels through ZNF652 regulation.

supplements.title: Unveiling the potential of zingerone-1,2,3-triazole derivatives as dual anticancer and COX-2 inhibitor: design, synthesis, and biological assessments.
supplements.summary: Researchers created new compounds combining zingerone and triazole that block COX-2 to fight cancer growth.

supplements.title: New Lignans with Different Degrees of Polymerization from Alpinia galanga: Their Chiral Resolution, Anti-Inflammatory Activity, and Mechanism.
supplements.summary: Compounds from greater galangal spice, particularly alpigalangin D, effectively reduce inflammation by blocking a key cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Vitamin C Alleviates BPA Embryotoxicity by Attenuating Oxidative Stress and DNA Damage-Mediated Apoptosis via Modulation of the ATM/Chk2/p53 Pathway.
supplements.summary: Vitamin C protects embryos from BPA toxicity by reducing oxidative stress and preventing DNA damage-related cell death.

supplements.title: Molecular targeting of the meningioma cell signaling circuit reveals drug vulnerabilities including synergy between sulforaphane and focal adhesion kinase inhibition.
supplements.summary: Sulforaphane combined with focal adhesion kinase inhibitors shows promise as a potential drug treatment for meningioma brain tumors.

supplements.title: Harnessing Phytochemicals for Brain Cancer Therapy: Insights Into Medulloblastoma and Glioblastoma Treatment.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds like curcumin and quercetin show promise treating aggressive brain cancers medulloblastoma and glioblastoma by stopping tumor cell growth and survival.

supplements.title: Cinnamon Bud Extract Is a Source of Biomolecules Active against the Aggregation and Condensation of Alzheimer's-Associated Tau Protein.
supplements.summary: Cinnamon bud extract prevents harmful tau protein clumping linked to Alzheimer's disease, reducing toxicity in brain cells.

supplements.title: Non-infectious environmental risk factors of multiple sclerosis: Mechanisms and intervention windows for prevention.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D supplementation and lifestyle changes during adolescence can help prevent multiple sclerosis by reducing environmental risk factors.

off_label.title: Multi-omics analysis of perfluorooctanoic acid and glioblastoma: insights from Mendelian randomization, network toxicology, and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Genetically higher PFOA levels causally increase glioblastoma risk through neuroinflammation and oncogenic pathways, suggesting environmental and therapeutic implications.

off_label.title: Therapy-induced cholesterol biosynthesis drives lung cancer dormancy and drug resistance.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer cells evade drug therapy by making cholesterol, triggering dormancy; combining cholesterol-blocking statins with cancer drugs prevents this escape.

off_label.title: Evidence-steered medicine in oncology: network-aware micro-combinations that safeguard standard of care and potentially improve benefit-risk.
off_label.summary: Evidence-steered medicine adds tiny, timed drug doses to standard cancer therapy to restore immune function and improve outcomes while maintaining safety.

off_label.title: Synergistic action of JNK activation and BChE inhibition: a novel anti- glioblastoma compound with neuroprotective profile.
off_label.summary: A new drug called QY-54 kills glioblastoma cancer cells while protecting healthy brain tissue through dual mechanisms.

off_label.title: Lansoprazole Enhances Everolimus Efficacy Through DDIT3-Mediated PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway Inhibition in Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Proliferation.
off_label.summary: Lansoprazole combined with everolimus more effectively treats pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors by blocking cancer growth pathways.

off_label.title: Clofibrate inhibits tumor immune escape by increasing macrophage phagocytosis.
off_label.summary: Clofibrate blocks lung cancer's immune escape by reducing CD47 protein, allowing immune cells to destroy tumors more effectively.

off_label.title: Unacylated Ghrelin Counteracts Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Neuromuscular Junction Disruption in Cancer Cachexia.
off_label.summary: Unacylated ghrelin treatment preserves muscle mass and function in lung cancer mice by restoring mitochondrial health and reducing muscle breakdown.

off_label.title: FDPS links tumor progression, phosphoproteomic reprogramming, and therapeutic vulnerability in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: FDPS protein drives liver cancer growth, and blocking it with pamidronate drug slows tumors in mice.

off_label.title: Cholesterol synthases suppress metastasis and stemness through PDIA4/ACLY or SYVN1/SCD1 axis in advanced colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking cholesterol-making enzymes in colorectal cancer unexpectedly promotes spread and stem cell traits, reversible by targeting fatty acid synthesis.

off_label.title: ANP32E drives lung adenocarcinoma progression via GSK3β-mediated glycolytic reprogramming.
off_label.summary: ANP32E protein drives lung adenocarcinoma growth by boosting cancer cell metabolism; blocking it with a new compound slows tumors.

off_label.title: GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy and liver fibrosis progression in MASLD with type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: Combining two diabetes drugs may slow liver fibrosis progression better than using one drug alone in patients with fatty liver disease.

off_label.title: Gastroenterology/Hepatology: What You May Have Missed in 2025.
off_label.summary: Exercise after colon cancer surgery and treatment reduces recurrence and improves survival in patients.

off_label.title: Associations of aspirin use with pancreatic cancer risk: a meta-analysis of cohort studies with exploratory population- and exposure-stratified analyses.
off_label.summary: Aspirin use is associated with reduced pancreatic cancer risk, particularly in people with diabetes, normal weight, and non-drinkers.

off_label.title: Severe Pharyngo-Laryngeal Mucositis During Radiotherapy in a Patient Receiving Colchicine: A Case Report.
off_label.summary: Colchicine use during radiotherapy for throat cancer unexpectedly worsened mouth and throat damage, suggesting a dangerous drug-radiation interaction.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetic Prediction of Repurposed Drugs for PDAC Using Artificial Intelligence.
off_label.summary: AI models accurately predict how repurposed drugs behave in the body for pancreatic cancer treatment.

biomarkers.title: Effects of Psychosocial Interventions on Measures of Stress Among Breast Cancer Survivors: A Scoping Review.
biomarkers.summary: Psychosocial interventions effectively reduce stress in breast cancer survivors, potentially improving immune function and survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Neoplastic Cauda Equina Syndrome: When Do We Not Operate?
biomarkers.summary: Burkitt lymphoma caused spinal cord compression in a teen that improved quickly with treatment, avoiding surgery.

biomarkers.title: WWOX maintains epidermal identity and suppresses EMT to prevent aggressive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: WWOX protein prevents aggressive skin cancer by stabilizing p63 and blocking cells from losing their identity.

biomarkers.title: Self-adjuvanting α-helical polypeptide simultaneously delivers neoantigen mRNAs and activates dendritic cells to eradicate tumors.
biomarkers.summary: New polypeptide delivery system combines cancer neoantigen mRNA with immune activation, achieving 83% tumor-free survival in lymphoma models.

biomarkers.title: FABP7 controls radial glial scaffold stability during human cortical development.
biomarkers.summary: FABP7 protein maintains brain cell scaffolds critical for proper neural development; its loss disrupts this process and may contribute to autism.

biomarkers.title: Patient-derived pediatric brain tumor orthotopic xenografts and tumor organoids faithfully recapitulate primary tumors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed lab-grown pediatric brain tumor models that accurately preserve tumor characteristics, enabling faster drug testing and therapy discovery.

biomarkers.title: Multiomics profiling and experiments in preclinical models revealed RAD51-IN-1 as a synergistic potentiator of anlotinib sensitivity.
biomarkers.summary: RAD51 inhibitor RAD51-IN-1 enhances anlotinib effectiveness in ovarian cancer by overcoming drug resistance mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Brief Communication: Personalized Circulating Tumor DNA as a Predictor of Pathologic Response in Neoadjuvant Treatment of Resectable Melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Circulating tumor DNA levels predict whether melanoma patients will respond to immune therapy before surgery, enabling personalized treatment decisions.

biomarkers.title: The emerging landscape of lncRNAs in gastric cancer immunity: From immune escape to ferroptosis and metabolic reprogramming.
biomarkers.summary: Long noncoding RNAs regulate immune escape in gastric cancer, offering potential therapeutic targets to improve immunotherapy response and patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Co-activating the intrinsic FcRγ/TLR4 signaling axis enhances the antitumor activity of NKG2D CAR-macrophages against prostate cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Engineered immune cells called CAR-macrophages with dual signaling pathways effectively shrink prostate cancer tumors in mice without toxicity.

biomarkers.summary: Berberine, a natural compound from Chinese herbal medicine, kills papillary thyroid cancer cells by triggering a specific cell death pathway.

biomarkers.title: Elevation of serum N-glycolylneuraminic acid glycoconjugates in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A blood test measuring Neu5Gc molecules accurately identifies colorectal cancer with 94% sensitivity and 79% specificity.

biomarkers.title: Hypoxia-induced LGALS8-AS1 sustains oxidative phosphorylation to drive breast cancer progression.
biomarkers.summary: A hypoxia-activated gene called LGALS8-AS1 fuels breast cancer growth by keeping mitochondria energized, offering a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Integrated phytochemical and computational approaches to identify candidate Bcl-2 inhibitors from Caesalpinia mimosoides: Toward translational anticancer strategies.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified plant compounds from Caesalpinia mimosoides that effectively block Bcl-2 cancer protein, offering natural alternatives to synthetic drugs.

biomarkers.title: How cytochrome P450 enzymes in humans are involved in Parkinson's disease: a literature review.
biomarkers.summary: Multiple cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to Parkinson's disease through oxidative stress, dopamine metabolism, and neuroinflammation pathways.

trials.summary: Brigatinib shows promise for treating rare cancers with ALK mutations beyond lung cancer using a decentralized trial approach.

trials.summary: A new targeted sequencing test accurately classifies diffuse large B-cell lymphoma subtypes, enabling personalized treatment strategies at lower cost.

trials.title: BLADE: Breast Lesion Analysis with Domain Expertise for DCE-MRI Diagnosis.
trials.summary: BLADE, an AI tool combining deep learning with clinical expertise, improves breast cancer diagnosis from MRI scans and boosts radiologist accuracy by 14%.

trials.summary: Researchers mapped cell-cell interactions in Alzheimer's brains, finding specific communication patterns between neurons and brain cells linked to dementia severity.

mind_body.title: The effectiveness of electroacupuncture in the treatment of cancer-related fatigue: a systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture appears to help reduce fatigue in cancer patients, though more research is needed to confirm effectiveness.

mind_body.title: Spirituality and Religiosity in Adults With Head and Neck Cancer: A Scoping Review of Concepts, Measures, and Outcomes.
mind_body.summary: Spirituality and religiosity may help improve health outcomes in head and neck cancer patients, but research needs standardized measurement approaches.

mind_body.title: Effects of Psychosocial Interventions on Measures of Stress Among Breast Cancer Survivors: A Scoping Review.
mind_body.summary: Psychosocial interventions effectively reduce stress in breast cancer survivors, potentially improving immune function and survival outcomes.

mind_body.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Gastrointestinal Dysfunction: Mechanisms and Integrative Western-Chinese Medicine Strategies.
mind_body.summary: Chemotherapy damages the gut through multiple interconnected processes; combined Western and Chinese medicine approaches targeting specific mechanisms may better prevent and treat these side effects.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Integrative Oncology Approaches to Address Chemotherapy-induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Gastrointestinal (GI) Cancer Patients: A SMART Pilot Study
mind_body.summary: Study tests whether Tai Chi, supplements, or acupuncture can reduce nerve damage caused by chemotherapy in gastrointestinal cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effects of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on the Psychological Well-Being of Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions significantly reduce anxiety and depression in family caregivers of cancer patients.

mind_body.title: eHealth Mindfulness-based Music Therapy Intervention for Patients Undergoing Stem Cell Transplantation
mind_body.summary: Researchers are testing an online mindfulness and music therapy program to improve quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: Community-Engaged Pilot Testing of Talking About Cancer (TAC) to Improve Engagement in Advance Care Planning
mind_body.summary: Telephone coaching helps advanced cancer patients and caregivers plan end-of-life care through guided conversations and advance directives.

mind_body.title: Dehydration in the Dying Process: An Integrative Systematic Review of Physiological Mechanisms and Clinical Implications.
mind_body.summary: Terminal dehydration in dying patients is an adaptive process; artificial hydration increases respiratory secretions and discomfort without clear benefits.

mind_body.title: Psychotherapeutic Techniques for Dyspnea in Cancer and Chronic Illness: Systematic Review.
mind_body.summary: Psychotherapy techniques effectively help cancer and seriously ill patients manage breathing difficulties, though delivery methods need better understanding.

mind_body.title: Pilot study of the DeStress for Health Program: a community-engaged stress reduction and cancer prevention intervention for rural communities.
mind_body.summary: A stress-reduction program showed promise in helping rural communities adopt healthier behaviors that could lower cancer risk.

mind_body.title: AI-enabled psychometric and psychophysiological assessment in psychiatric comorbidity of oncology patients: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: AI tools can better detect depression and anxiety in cancer patients by continuously monitoring psychological distress beyond traditional screening methods.

mind_body.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
mind_body.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

mind_body.title: Communication skill training in surgical residency: insights from Y-SICO (Young-Italian Society of Surgical Oncology).
mind_body.summary: Most surgical residents lack formal communication training despite recognizing its importance for delivering difficult diagnoses and managing patient care.

mind_body.title: Beyond tumor biology: nursing interventions for psychological and immune health in cancer patients.
mind_body.summary: Nursing interventions combining therapy, mindfulness, and lifestyle support improve psychological well-being and immune function in cancer patients.
